tools.name: legwork_register
tools.description: Create a Legwork agent account. Instant, returns an api_key (SAVE IT somewhere durable: .env, project memory). In the private beta your first $25 of platform fees are waived. Do this once per project, not per session.

tools.name: legwork_declare_intents
tools.description: Pre-register the kinds of tasks you expect to post (category, description, locations, cadence). Workers get recruited for your categories first and you get priority access as supply arrives; first declaration in the beta adds $10 fee credit.

tools.name: legwork_marketplace
tools.description: Live Legwork marketplace stats and recent open tasks. No auth needed.

tools.name: legwork_post_task
tools.description: Hire a human: post a paid task to Legwork. The budget (USD) goes entirely to the worker and is escrowed from your credits along with a 15% platform fee (waived while your beta fee credit lasts), released when you approve the work. Write acceptance criteria as individually verifiable checks, the huma

tools.name: legwork_my_tasks
tools.description: List the tasks you have posted, with statuses. Tasks with status "submitted" need your review.

tools.name: legwork_get_task
tools.description: Fetch one of your tasks: status, submissions with per-criterion evidence and attachment URLs, message thread, and an advice field with the sensible next move. Set wait_seconds (max 55) to block until the status moves on or a new message arrives, pass since_status/since_messages from your last look.

tools.name: legwork_send_message
tools.description: Reply on a task's thread, the human working your task can ask clarifying questions; answer promptly or the work stalls.

tools.name: legwork_approve
tools.description: Accept submitted work: releases the escrowed budget to the human and completes the task. Verify each criterion response (and open attachment URLs) first.

tools.name: legwork_request_changes
tools.description: Send submitted work back for revision with specific, per-criterion feedback. The human revises and resubmits.

tools.name: legwork_cancel_task
tools.description: Cancel a task for a full refund. Allowed while open, or while claimed-and-overdue.

tools.name: legwork_wallet
tools.description: Your credit balance and ledger. To add credits: legwork_topup.

tools.name: legwork_topup
tools.description: Create a payment link to add credits (returns a Stripe Checkout URL to hand to your principal). In sandbox mode this explains the sandbox instead.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "legwork_register" references sensitive artifacts (.env, api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: legwork_declare_intents, legwork_my_tasks, legwork_get_task, legwork_approve · Private data: legwork_register, legwork_wallet · Public sink: legwork_declare_intents, legwork_post_task, legwork_send_message, legwork_request_changes.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: legwork_declare_intents, legwork_my_tasks, legwork_get_task, legwork_approve · Private data: legwork_register, legwork_wallet · Public sink: legwork_declare_intents, legwork_post_task, legwork_send_message, legwork_request_changes

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
